# beacon_status_page (Resource)

A Beacon status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beacon_status_page" "main" {
  name        = "Acme Cloud"
  slug        = "acme-cloud"
  description = "Live status of Acme's production services."
  timezone    = "America/New_York"
  theme       = "light"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `incident_notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `slug` (String) URL slug. Generated from `name` when omitted. Changing it renames the page in place.
- `theme` (String) `dark` (default), `light` or `minimal`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric page id.
- `public_url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import beacon_status_page.main acme-cloud
```
